description: Returns the X calls on the authenticated user's calendar, earliest first: events on their X Calls calendar, and events on the Microsoft Outlook calendars they linked to X whose conference is an X call. Calls still running at start_time are included. The window defaults to the next 24 hours and may span at most 7 days. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned. When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`.

call.fields.description: A comma separated list of Call fields to display.

end_time.description: Calls starting before this time (RFC 3339). Defaults to 24 hours after start_time.

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand.

max_results.description: The most calls to return. Defaults to 20.

scheduled_call.fields.description: A comma separated list of ScheduledCall fields to display.

start_time.description: Calls still running at this time or starting after it (RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

user.fields.description: A comma separated list of User fields to display.
